summary_ja: リテール向けエクスポージャーをプールに割り当てる際に満たすべき要件を定める。
summary_en: Sets the requirements to be met in allocating retail exposures to pools.
paragraphs: In allocating retail exposures to pools, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall satisfy all of the following requirements: (i) The PD, LGD and EAD of each pool are quantified; (ii) The number of exposures in each pool is sufficient to enable quantification and validation of PD, LGD and EAD at the pool level; (iii) When multiple pools are compared, the obligors and exposures allocated to each pool are appropriate; (iv) Exposures are not unduly concentrated in a single pool.
